description: Low-ownership fantasy football players with high upside potential. Updated weekly with ownership data from Sleeper API and historical performance projections.

columns.name: team
columns.description: 3-letter NFL team abbreviation. Sourced directly from bronze_sleeper_ownership (fixed June 5, 2026)
columns.notes: Previously showed 'UNK' for 71% of records due to wrong data source. Now 100% accurate.

columns.name: ownership_pct
columns.description: Percentage of Sleeper leagues rostering this player (0-100)

columns.name: projected_pts
columns.description: Average fantasy points per game from last 8 weeks of 2025 season (weeks 10-18). Zero for players without recent stats.
columns.notes: 71% of sleepers have 0 projected pts (deep bench players with no recent game time). Use has_projection field to distinguish.

columns.name: has_projection
columns.description: True if player has historical stats from 2025 season (weeks 10+). False for deep sleepers without recent game data.
columns.notes: NEW FIELD. Helps frontend distinguish between 'no data' vs 'low scoring' players.

columns.name: value_score
columns.description: Calculated as (100 - ownership_pct). Higher score = better sleeper candidate.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Categorized reason for sleeper status based on projected points

validation_rules: position must be QB, RB, WR, or TE (no defensive players)
team field must not be 'UNK' (alert if >10% UNK)

frontend_usage.primary_use: Waiver wire recommendations and deep sleeper discovery

filtering.by_position: Filter to specific positions (QB, RB, WR, TE)
filtering.by_projection: Use has_projection=true to show only players with stats
filtering.by_ownership: Show only players below certain ownership threshold

display_recommendations: Show 'No recent stats' badge if has_projection=false
Highlight players with projected_pts >= 10 as 'High upside'
Link to player profile for deeper analysis

known_issues.explanation: Deep sleepers often lack recent stats. Use has_projection field to handle this.

known_issues.issue: Team field showing 'UNK' for 71% of records
known_issues.explanation: Was pulling team from gold_player_dim instead of bronze_sleeper_ownership. Now using bronze source directly.

changes: Improved reason categorization based on projected points
